sections.title: Paperwork
items: Logbook (V5C): number of keepers, and whether it's a fresh import
MOT history on GOV.UK: advisories and failures
Proof the import duty and VAT were paid
Japanese auction sheet: grade and damage map. 'R' or 'RA' means accident repair. Doctored sheets do exist.
Frame number for a Japanese history report (e.g. CarVX): auctions, mileage readings, accidents
Service records and stickers (Japanese stickers use Japanese dates)
Outstanding recalls

sections.title: Outside
items: Paint faults, dents and mismatched panels. Compare with the auction sheet.
Both sliding doors open and close smoothly, under power and by hand
Tailgate closes fully; power/soft-close works
Sunroof works, seals not cracked
Headlights not yellowed; every bulb works
Wheels: no bubbling or kerb damage; tyre age, tread, and summer or winter tyres
Spare tyre present
Underside: damage and corrosion. Ask why if it's been freshly undersealed.
Brake disc lips and pad thickness

sections.title: Engine bay
items: Rust on strut tops and painted metal
Oil or fluid leaks; split or perished hoses; white crust at hose ends (coolant leaks)
Oil golden to dark brown, not black or sludgy; clean filler cap
Coolant pink/red and clean
Battery secure; health indicator (if fitted) shows good
Brake and power steering fluid levels
Engine running: no ticking, grinding or belt squeal

sections.title: Inside
items: Seats fold, slide and recline (power ottomans on higher grades); no tears or burns
Smells: smoking or damp, possibly masked
Seatbelts and trim all present; floor mats
Speedometer shows mph (converted or overlaid)
Radio band expander fitted and working
Sat-nav/touchscreen, cameras, rear DVD screen (if fitted)
Front and rear air conditioning both blow cold
All windows, central locking, mirrors, sunshades, interior lights
Window tint not bubbled; check it's legal for the front windows in the UK

sections.title: Test drive
items: At least two keys
Drives straight and doesn't pull under braking
Smooth gear changes / CVT with no judder or jolts
No knocks over bumps; nothing from the rear axle
No clicking from the CV joints on full lock
Steering and brakes feel right; no warning lights
